Defaults are starting values, not immutable laws unless a safety/domain reason requires non-configurability.
supersedes: Arabic-first, fixed RTL, fixed theme/layout formulations.

decision: Library Editor v1.2.17 is the currently accepted executable design donor; compatible mechanics must be mined directly.
supersedes: Inference that latest candidate equals accepted blueprint.

Maximize executable reuse across all 23 surfaces using global foundation, family engines, and thin domain adapters.
Accepted Library editor mechanics become reusable executable structured/editor primitives for Learn and all compatible authoring surfaces.
Spatial mechanics become one reusable engine with domain adapters for Visualize/W03/eligible consumers.
Read canonical authority/supersession before raw candidates; historical framework paths/classes/routes are not new-foundation architecture authority.
supersedes: Historical production paths treated as current target.

decision: Preserve accepted Library donor value while applying exact newer Owner corrections only to affected mechanics.
supersedes: Whole-donor rejection for one corrected mechanic.

decision: Current Shell/navigation visual composition is not accepted as strong/final. Mine useful interaction/context mechanics, but redesign global shell/navigation after shared workbench foundation is stable.

Provide executable universal layout/slot templates. Shared pane/toolbar/context/action surfaces keep the same layout grammar, design language, placement grammar and interaction model; surfaces change domain content/actions only.

Command Palette, Context Action Menu, Selection Action Surface and similar reusable action containers use common executable templates; only command groups/capability bindings change.

Learn should feel like the Library-grade workbench/editor with learning-specific journey/practice/assessment/lab/progress/recommendation additions; do not resurrect the old consumption-only/no-authoring CENTER restriction.
supersedes: Old Learn no-authoring CENTER / read-only-first authority.

Vue/TypeScript/Vite/Vue Flow/Electron/Tauri/Python bridge/SQLite/xterm.js are candidates or specialized tools only; no final stack freeze before measured proof.
Foundation outputs must be executable/reusable components/templates/cores plus machine-readable contracts and tests, not merely guidelines or reference prose.
Foundation and surface contracts should constrain future Writers so generic design/interaction choices are inherited, not reinvented. Deviations require explicit justification.
supersedes: Writer-local design discretion for shared mechanics.

decision: Empty block/note initial direction follows active OS keyboard hint through InputDirectionResolver with truthful fallback; explicit persisted block direction wins.
verification: RTL/LTR/unknown bridge states + real consumers; never infer domain language.

decision: Central UI Scale applies to chrome/panes/controls/spacing/typography and stays separate from document/canvas zoom, density and responsive breakpoints.
verification: 0.8/1/2 visual+geometry propagation; no surface-local scale variables.

decision: Grouped Preferences/Settings/Commands/Editor Shortcuts/Shortcuts use one-open disclosure, search, keyboard navigation and applicability-filtered sections.

Sticky Notes use shared StickyNoteWindowOwner: internal scroll, all-edge/corner resize, reachable toolbar, responsive bounds, z-order, pin intent, separate-window control; OS always-on-top only where a real platform capability proves it.
verification: Library + non-Library lifecycle; close/hide != delete; no donor-local duplicate.

verification: Move focus while panel remains visible; execution suppressed correctly; IME proof.

decision: Library is a normal consumer plus donor/regression oracle; generic improvements must be implemented centrally and propagate to every applicable surface, not patched Library-only.
Reuse means Presentation + Behavior + Interaction + Functionality, not semantics alone. Writers must not locally reinvent any shared dimension.
Acceptance is based on the actual visible and interactable result: appearance, interaction, functionality, responsive behavior, Bidi/accessibility and truthful state/data.
Every material component counts, including small controls, icons/affordances, tree items, menus, toolbars, content chrome, states, transients and panes.
Controller is accountable for mission design, scope isolation, falsification, convergence and acceptance. Writer PASS never transfers that responsibility.

Mandatory review chain: Writer → Independent Audit → exact source/scope audit → Browser/Runtime comparison → Owner-Decisions audit → Reuse/duplicate-owner audit → data/provider truth audit → integrated regression → Acceptance/Correction.
Every Owner decision and applicable enhancement must have explicit zero-loss disposition. Long chats or missing Writer mentions may never erase a decision.
ChatGPT Project static instructions must use stable live pointers/read sets and must not hardcode changing epochs, hashes, active missions or readiness counts.
Every substantive CEP Controller response must refresh the live governance/current-state set and applicable Owner decisions instead of relying on chat memory.
Before classifying, modifying, archiving or deleting governance artifacts, inspect their content recursively where material; never infer authority/value from filenames alone.
Historical files may contain durable laws, lessons and accepted-value evidence. Distill useful knowledge while preventing historical state from becoming current authority.

Future Writers should receive small bounded tasks and mostly compose/configure/bind/test prebuilt reusable owners; generic design/behavior/presentation invention belongs in Foundation correction, not Surface Writer discretion.

Where applicable, compare reused components step-by-step against current Owner decisions and accepted runtime/donor value across presentation, behavior, interaction, responsive states and accessibility—not only broad screenshots.

`/Google Drive/cep_building_mgm` is the durable CEP governance/control workspace and should contain the live pointers, Controller operating rules, decision indices, evidence maps, review protocols and execution custody needed to reconstruct state without chat memory.

Canonical governance files use stable names and in-place updates. New governance files are admitted only for a genuinely distinct semantic/machine-readable role. Overlapping governance documents must be read, zero-loss distilled into the canonical file, and archived rather than proliferated.

Direct Owner visual rejection of a Presentation result immediately invalidates lower Writer/Auditor Presentation PASS/READY tokens for that result and blocks convergence/promotion until corrected and re-proven.
Fixture/demo/synthetic consumers may support testing but never satisfy real-consumer Presentation reuse, donor parity, second-consumer or cutover acceptance.

For accepted donor generic Presentation, reuse means extract/refactor actual accepted value into the canonical owner and rebind the donor; building a parallel simplified/lookalike implementation is not extraction.
For each applicable component/state not explicitly superseded, accepted donor value is the minimum quality/value floor. Materially weaker/thin/partial/unproven Presentation is a blocking failure.

Controller must grant/serialize the real source seams needed to achieve an extraction mission. It is forbidden to prohibit the true donor/runtime seam and accept a fixture/parallel substitute instead.
Presentation acceptance requires component-by-component donor-vs-candidate proof on real consumer paths at matching states and viewports, including 1440 and approximately 1024 where applicable.

E19 A/B/C/D Presentation candidates and E19_PARALLEL_LANES_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_CONVERGENCE are rejected for Presentation acceptance by Owner visual review. Do not execute Lane F convergence. Salvage only independently adjudicated subordinate value.

Before any Presentation acceptance, Controller must directly inspect and expose an Owner-readable component/state evidence sheet. Evidence hidden only inside ZIPs/reports is insufficient acceptance workflow.

Top-level readiness/acceptance may never exceed the worst unresolved applicable row/finding. 'Materially addressed', 'bounded scope' or 'Controller later' cannot downgrade a blocker without direct closure evidence.

Historical planning/owner-lock matrices are durable collision evidence, not current mission authority. Reconcile them with current source and Owner decisions before use; if a lock blocks the true objective, serialize the hotspot rather than invent a substitute.
The sole live CEP governance/execution custody root is /Google Drive/cep_building_mgm. File Library CEP paths are retired from live operation after zero-loss migration verification.

All live CURRENT_STATE, governance, Writer/Auditor inputs, outputs, Controller inboxes, accepted-successor custody and future mission paths must use the Google Drive CEP root and be maintained there in place.

Library-era absolute CEP paths embedded in immutable historical receipts, reports or evidence are historical provenance only. They must not be rewritten when doing so would falsify what the evidence recorded, and they never authorize a current launch path.

The CEP management tree must migrate to Google Drive with zero file loss and preserved relative structure. Retire the File Library source only after destination verification proves the moved corpus is complete; failed moves remain source-side until retried.

Supporting census/manifests/stale registers/inventories/maps/pointers never create current state, accepted implementation, Owner, launch, readiness or promotion authority. Any conflict with the live authority chain is stale and must be corrected before mission launch or acceptance.

CEP is a personal/local single-owner product. Prioritize the best functional, visual and practical result on the Owner's local machine. Exact dependency/tool versions or production-grade reproducibility are not blocking by themselves; substitutions are allowed when they preserve compatibility, data integrity and equal-or-better result quality. Keep the stack as simple as practical, but admit an additional tool when it materially improves the result.

No historical/superseded INPUT, START_HERE, CURRENT_AUTHORITY, AUTHORIZED, READY, launch packet, Writer prompt, correction packet, release authority or execution manifest is launchable merely because it exists or contains self-authorizing text. A mission may launch only when CURRENT_STATE explicitly authorizes the mission class and the Controller binds the exact current mission/path/parent under current governance.

A mutating Writer works only in an isolated private candidate derived from the exact Controller-approved parent and never mutates an accepted successor in place. Overlapping/shared-hotspot candidates are accepted sequentially through Controller-controlled rebase/replay/integration and full re-verification; parallel mutation never writes to one canonical working tree.

CEP visual/browser evidence must treat local-process reachability, browser process launch, browser URL navigation, rendering, screenshot creation, and actual image inspection as separate capabilities. Before declaring visual capture blocked, use the bounded local/offline recovery ladder, including explicit executable paths, navigation-independent exact-current-candidate rendering where provenance is exact, validated offline browser packages, standalone Chrome Headless Shell after full-Chrome container failure, and other already-available compatible engines as applicable. Do not modify product architecture merely to obtain screenshots, and never relabel historical screenshots as fresh current-candidate evidence.

Launch the maximum number of genuinely independent isolated Writers from the same exact accepted parent when the dependency/collision graph permits; do not artificially serialize Writer execution merely because review or acceptance will be batched. Partition convergence and independent review into coherent bounded groups based on shared owners/hotspots when scale warrants it. Each grouped audit must still adjudicate every candidate/delta explicitly; convergence may replay only Controller-approved deltas; each converged group requires independent post-convergence verification, followed by final integrated cross-group regression/audit.

Any substantial CEP Heavy Chat must, on explicit Owner checkpoint request, materialize a self-contained source-bound continuity package that preserves the exact coherent working candidate, hashes, applied-change/finding/phase ledgers, evidence index, revalidation/invalidation map, input consumption, Owner-decision progress and exact resume instructions so a fresh chat can continue from verified work without reconstructing chat history or blindly redoing completed work. The checkpoint never overrides newer live authority and stale proof must be rerun only when invalidated by subsequent source/state changes or by mandatory final integrated gates.

Optimize CEP parallel execution for maximum useful/value-weighted parallelism, not maximum Writer count. Choose the smallest number of coherent independent execution lanes that minimizes time-to-accepted-result while preserving quality, scope isolation and safe collision control. Do not fragment coherent work into many tiny Writers when fewer Writers or Controller-owned bounded execution achieves equal or better throughput. Use expected work size/duration, dependency/collision DAG, review/integration overhead and evidence burden to choose lane count.

For CEP runtime/persistence/local-or-OS bridge/terminal/native-window/dependency/deferred-capability questions, a Controller must resolve current authority first, then read the canonical durable technical reference and lessons/dependency ledger, reconcile them against the exact current accepted source and live Owner decisions, and consult archived working memory or exact historical wave evidence only for missing provenance/rationale. Summary inventories, package dependency lists, enhancement backlogs, filenames, cross-project choices, or historical status lines are never sufficient by themselves to classify a technology/capability as selected, rejected, required, deferred, implemented, or obsolete. Every applicable future readiness/mission must preserve a zero-loss disposition of role, owner, implementation state, proof gate, deferral reason, target consumer and platform-proof requirement.

Prefer managed/remote target execution for scriptable target-platform proof when a controlled runner can truthfully exercise the required OS/runtime/filesystem/network semantics. The Owner personal machine is not required merely because a gate targets Windows. Use the Owner machine only for capabilities that inherently depend on the real Owner desktop/session/hardware or cannot be truthfully certified on a managed runner (for example native HWND/OS always-on-top or active keyboard-source behavior). Execution carriers and CI repositories remain non-authoritative and must not become CEP source/state authority.

For closing OE-001 and OE-004, use a narrow replaceable Win32 sidecar helper as the implementation target behind PlatformWindowCapability and PlatformInputDirectionCapability. CEP semantic owners remain in the existing TypeScript/Node layers; do not adopt Electron, Tauri, Python as a second application runtime, or PTY/PowerShell/SSH coupling merely to close these platform gates. Build/package the helper off the Owner machine where practical and deliver a bounded prebuilt Windows proof kit so the Owner device performs only the genuinely interactive desktop/session proof with minimal downloads. This selection does not freeze the overall CEP stack.

Operational Terminal floating presentation must share the reusable window mechanics expected for Sticky Notes where semantically applicable: all-edge/corner resize, CEP-internal pin intent, and separate/detached-window control. OS always-on-top remains a PlatformWindowCapability truth and may be claimed only after real platform proof. Terminal close/hide/detach presentation must not fabricate provider/session termination; runtime session identity and provider truth remain owned by OperationalSessionOwner/RuntimeAdapter. This window-parity decision does not itself define terminal runtime/provider selection; OD-20260917-049 separately requires the shared xterm renderer and real Windows PTY/ConPTY capability before stack freeze.
applies_to: Operational Terminal / Runs real consumer; PlatformWindowCapability second-real-consumer proof where applicable

decision: xterm.js is the canonical Terminal I/O Presentation renderer for CEP Operational terminal instances across InternalSimulationAdapter, real Windows PTY/ConPTY shells, recorded/read-only terminal playback, and future compatible runtime providers. xterm owns rendering/input interaction only, never semantic command truth or runtime state. Real terminal sessions use a provider-neutral raw terminal stream with no CEP-side command allowlist/parser or per-command provider model. One Windows PTY/ConPTY provider should serve arbitrary Owner-selected executable/shell profiles such as PowerShell, cmd.exe, WSL/Git Bash and other installed CLIs; SSH may run through that PTY stream using the system client or a specialized provider only when connection-management semantics materially justify it. Provider/session abstraction exists for lifecycle, identity, routing, resize, exit/error/restart and truthful capability state—not to restrict the Owner's commands, executables or providers. InternalSimulationAdapter remains a separate valid provider using the same xterm-backed renderer. Before STACK_FROZEN, prove xterm on real Operational consumers plus a real Windows PTY/ConPTY provider with raw I/O, resize, exit/error/restart and stable session identity.
applies_to: Operational Terminal; Runs terminal presentation; TerminalRuntimeCapability; Windows PTY/ConPTY; PowerShell; cmd.exe; SSH and future shell profiles

decision: CEP is a personal/local single-owner application. Security hardening must not delay, restrict, or reduce product functionality merely for security reasons. Do not add command/input filtering, executable/provider/session allowlists, RBAC/auth ceremony, sandboxing, provider whitelists, permission prompts, loopback-only policy, or security-driven feature/scope limits unless an external platform/API makes them technically unavoidable or the Owner later explicitly requests them. Choose boundaries from functionality, correctness, data integrity, lifecycle truth, simplicity, performance, compatibility and maintainability. Provider/session/capability abstractions may remain for routing, lifecycle, identity, replacement and truthful state, but not as security gates. No-security-restriction does not waive truth ceilings, data-integrity requirements, deterministic lifecycle/error handling, or external platform constraints.

Sticky Note content must consume the same canonical Structured editor engine, Presentation, Behavior, Interaction and Functionality as compatible full Structured authoring surfaces. Sticky-specific differences are limited to note window/chrome, note binding/domain context and bounded note-specific composition; no reduced editor fork or weaker interaction subset is allowed. While a Sticky Note is open, its title/body/blocks are directly editable by default and MUST NOT inherit or be disabled by the parent surface read/edit mode. Insertion gaps, block inspector/context actions, block delete/handling/reorder, pointer+keyboard selection including additive/range selection, clipboard, undo/redo, Bidi/input-direction behavior and other applicable Structured mechanics must come from the same canonical owners. Right-click on the Sticky insertion + must open the applicable insertion/block chooser rather than silently inserting a paragraph. No second Sticky-only editor engine.
applies_to: Sticky Notes on all note-capable surfaces; Structured editor reuse owners; Library/Learn parity oracle where compatible

decision: The Separate/Detached control associated with Sticky Notes and Operational Terminal must open the entire owning CEP surface in the separate/native window, preserving the current surface route/object/context and the relevant note or terminal as the focused/selected presentation context. Do not detach only a standalone Sticky Note or only a standalone terminal widget as the product-facing Separate behavior. CEP-internal pin remains available for both Sticky and Operational presentations where applicable; OS always-on-top remains a separately proven PlatformWindowCapability truth. Closing/hiding the detached surface must not delete note content or fabricate terminal provider/session termination.
applies_to: PlatformWindowCapability; Sticky Notes; Operational Terminal/Runs; global surface routing/context preservation

decision: Global Settings and per-surface Toolbar/Details must have distinct product roles. Settings owns durable/global/family preferences, configuration, command/shortcut discoverability and other persistent or broadly scoped choices. Toolbar/Details owns current-surface/current-object contextual state and actions. Do not duplicate the same global options/actions in both places as separate Presentation owners; when a contextual shortcut to a global command is useful, it must bind the same canonical command/preference owner and be visibly framed as a shortcut rather than a duplicate setting. Preserve the accepted progressive-disclosure grouping concept: one group open at a time and re-clicking the active group closes it, with search and keyboard access. The current visual hierarchy/style is not accepted merely because the grouping mechanics exist; redesign must improve clarity without inventing a second Settings engine.
applies_to: Global Settings; top navigation; toolbar Details/Actions; command/shortcut presentation across all 23 surfaces

decision: Restore and preserve the accepted Library donor insertion-gap interaction across every compatible Structured consumer, including Sticky Notes: primary/left click (and keyboard activation) on the insertion + opens the canonical insertion/block chooser at that exact gap; secondary/right click on the insertion + performs the fast direct action of inserting a Paragraph at that exact gap when the surface is editable. Do not swap these routes, collapse both into the chooser, or replace them with a surface-local fork. Sticky inherits this same canonical interaction while remaining always editable under OD-20260917-051.
supersedes: OD-20260917-051 right-click-insertion-chooser clause only; preserves all other OD-20260917-051 requirements.
applies_to: Library; Learn; Sticky Notes; every Structured-compatible authoring surface and shared Structured insertion owner

decision: The current M0/A6 result must not be accepted, promoted, or treated as surface-complete where it loses or genericizes the governed identity, purpose, workflows, region composition, commands, state semantics, original recoverable reference value, or applicable Owner decisions of any CEP surface. Before rescue mutation, the Controller must reconstruct a zero-loss 23-surface identity/reference matrix from current SurfaceProfiles and requirement index, applicable live Owner decisions, exact accepted/shared donors, and classified original surface references/value-recovery evidence. Each surface must then compose the required shared owners through its own typed domain/data/provider truth and required TOP/TOOLBAR/LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT/BOTTOM/TRANSIENT roles. Route reachability, generic JSON/truth stages, shared-owner presence, smoke PASS, tests, or screenshots never substitute for surface-purpose/function completeness. Owner direct hands-on rejection overrides lower CLEAN/PASS claims for the affected result.
supersedes: Any interpretation that 23/23 route smoke, generic controller composition, shared-owner binding alone, or prior A6 shard CLEAN is sufficient Surface acceptance.
applies_to: All 23 CEP surfaces; final A6 synthesis; any rescue/convergence mission; all shared-family consumers

decision: Enterprise, Scenarios, Labs, Runs and Results are workspaces/studios, not surfaces governed by a universal Read/Edit mode. Their default product interaction is active work according to each surface purpose and the selected object lifecycle: modeling/authoring for Enterprise, Scenarios and Labs; operational control for Runs; historical analysis/replay/AAR/compare for Results. Nodes, relations, phases, events, tasks, runtime objects, replay cursors and analytical selections remain directly interactive whenever the domain state, provider truth and command authority permit. Immutability applies to specific published/sealed artifacts and facts—not to the whole surface. Published Enterprise/Twin/Scenario/Lab revisions, Baselines, immutable Run Manifests and sealed Result/Event facts must be changed only through clone/new/superseding revision or the authorized lifecycle action; this must not be implemented by converting the owning workspace into a global read-only mode. A Read/Edit control is allowed only for compatible Structured document/editor content where actual object editability requires it; it is not a universal W03 surface mode and must not gate unrelated Studio interactions or Sticky Note editability.
applies_to: W03 Enterprise; Scenarios; Labs; Runs; Results; their toolbar/action availability; Structured-compatible embedded content; rescue missions and acceptance proof

decision: For the post-M0 zero-loss rescue, use value-weighted balanced specialist execution rather than overloading a few broad Writers or fragmenting into gratuitous micro-Writers. Partition mutable work first by canonical owner/seam and collision boundary, then by coherent surface/domain family. Each specialist must have a bounded medium-sized workload, exact path/owner locks, current Owner decisions and matrix rows, and must return an exact delta/evidence package. After specialist results, use one bounded Coverage/Convergence Writer per coherent group to consume only Controller-approved deltas, close group-level omissions and real-consumer composition, then run an independent group audit before global convergence. Shared hotspots and final wiring remain serialized; sibling ZIP overlay is forbidden. Parallelism is optimized for time-to-complete accepted product quality, completeness and reviewability, not Writer count.

Shared global/family owners govern compatible Presentation grammar, placement, slots, pane/window/focus/overflow/responsive behavior and reusable interaction mechanics. They do not own or standardize every Surface's command inventory, labels, content, workflow, lifecycle, data, provider truth or semantic effects. Each SurfaceProfile and its domain/provider owners supply those Surface-specific truths through thin adapters and composition. Library is an accepted donor and normal consumer, not the universal semantic or action template. Learn inherits the maximum compatible Structured/Library mechanics while preserving Learning semantics; other Surfaces consume only the shared mechanics justified by their own identity. Toolbar composition is two-layered: a small explicitly classified universal action set plus Surface-specific contextual/domain actions and availability predicates.

Protect the current simple CEP stack from unproven expansion. The admitted baseline is Node.js/TypeScript, browser-native UI, local node:http transport, node:sqlite behind the existing persistence boundary, @xterm/xterm as Terminal renderer, the narrow C++17 Win32/ConPTY sidecar behind platform capabilities, and Playwright as development/test evidence tooling. A Writer may not add an application framework, ORM, database driver/service, queue, second application runtime, desktop shell, bridge technology or Product dependency unless an exact current requirement proves the existing stack cannot satisfy the needed function and the Controller records an explicit dependency-admission disposition. Compatible build/test/capture tool or version substitution is not Product-stack expansion. STACK_EXPANSION_LOCKED does not equal STACK_FROZEN; final freeze still requires accepted Windows/xterm/PTY/ConPTY and applicable platform capability proof.

Writer-facing GitHub repositories and self-contained execution packages must contain the exact Product parent plus a Controller-distilled task authority packet, not mutable live Controller state or a wholesale copy of Controller governance. Do not include live CURRENT_STATE.md, full CONTROLLER_GOVERNANCE.md, full OWNER_DECISION_LIVE_REGISTER.csv, or unrelated Controller review/history merely for self-containment. Include the exact current mission; exact parent/source/package identity; all Owner decisions applicable to that mission with their binding text and verification expectations; exact affected SurfaceProfiles; applicable domain/oracle/visual references; protected truths; writable/read-only/prohibited boundaries; acceptance/falsification gates; known environment/truth ceilings; and the minimum Controller handoff/evidence required to reproduce the task. The repository is an execution input, never acceptance authority. If the Controller declares the packaged authority packet stale or a newer Owner decision materially changes the task, execution must stop until the packet is refreshed.

For the exact Presentation CORR02 Writer bootstrap, the Owner explicitly requires the selected existing GitHub repository `hamad933/cep-writer-baseline-repo` to remain PUBLIC. Public visibility is intentional and is not a bootstrap blocker. The bootstrap must verify the exact repository identity, require the remote to be empty, target only branch `main`, use the notebook variable `token` for authenticated write access without printing or persisting it in the remote URL, stage only manifest-authorized paths, and refuse force-push or overwrite. This decision supersedes only the prior Private-visibility requirement in OD-20260921-063/064; all other exact Drive-ID, SHA, manifest, Product identity, token, empty-remote, no-force, and branch gates remain unchanged.

For the long-lived CEP Writer GitHub repository, `main` is the Controller-bound Writer baseline branch, not a free Writer worktree and not automatic CEP acceptance authority. Every mutating Writer mission must start from an exact Controller-bound `main` commit and work on one mission-specific candidate branch. Writers may commit/push only to that bound candidate branch and must never push directly to `main`, merge to `main`, create a release, self-promote, or mutate live Controller governance. Product changes belong only to genuine Product paths. `cep-writer/` remains Controller-owned read-only task authority. Small textual Writer handoff/evidence may be written under the mission's bounded `writer-output/<mission>/` path; heavy ZIPs/screenshots/baselines are not committed unless a mission explicitly requires them. The Controller audits the exact candidate-branch HEAD. Only after Controller acceptance may the Controller integrate the admitted Product delta into `main`, update Drive acceptance/live state, and refresh the same `cep-writer/` task packet for the next mission. Git history preserves old packets; do not create accumulating Writer-history folders merely for lineage.

The long-lived CEP GitHub Writer repository must be self-contained for Writer execution inputs. `main` must carry the current Controller-bound Product baseline plus every reusable/current Writer-readable input that a competent Writer may need without fetching live Controller files from Google Drive: required build/test tooling, contracts/profiles, current governed visual-reference assets, applicable domain/oracle/technical references, Writer-relevant Owner-decision snapshots, protected-truth/acceptance rules, and repository workflow guidance. A mission branch inherits those inputs from exact `main` and adds only the exact immutable mission/task overlay and any additional task-specific input not already present. Required reference images/PDFs/fixtures are INPUTS and remain in GitHub even when relatively large; do not remove them merely to minimize repository size. If an essential input is too large for ordinary Git, provide a deterministic Writer-consumable projection in the repository and preserve the original in Drive, or use another Git-native mechanism only after proving all intended Writer environments can consume it. Writer execution must not depend on live Drive lookups for required task inputs. Google Drive remains canonical for live Controller state/governance and for heavy GENERATED OUTPUT custody such as candidate/evidence/baseline ZIPs, large screenshot result sets, videos, generated reports and other bulky evidence. Branches may commit small handoff/results/receipts that bind external Drive outputs by file ID, SHA-256, bytes, source/commit identity and classification. Before any Writer branch launches, Controller must run a self-containment gate proving every mission-required input resolves to an in-repository path with exact hash/classification and no required Drive-only dependency.

For CEP Google AI Studio Writer missions, AI Studio built-in GitHub synchronization is treated as MAIN-only for this workflow and MUST NOT be relied on to read, materialize, track, or write a non-main mission branch. The mission prompt must direct AI Studio to create a separate manual Git working tree by cloning/fetching the exact public repository and checking out the exact Controller-bound candidate branch. If AI Studio already opened/imported a built-in-synced main workspace, that workspace remains read-only/non-mission and the Writer must not mutate it. All mission edits, build, preview, tests, screenshots and final handoff must operate from the manual candidate-branch clone only. The repository default branch remains `main`; do not change it merely for AI Studio. Before mutation, prove remote URL, branch name, exact starting HEAD, clean status, baseline ancestry and Product/source identity. During preparation and local preview phases no write credential is required for the public repository and no final push is allowed. After explicit Owner visual approval, branch push may use Git CLI against the exact candidate branch with a fine-grained GitHub token supplied only through an AI Studio Secret/environment variable or another non-echoing credential mechanism. Never paste the token into prompts/chat, print it, commit it, write it into files, or embed it persistently in the remote URL. Built-in sync must not be used as the mission publish path. This decision supersedes only the OD-20260921-068 assumptions that built-in AI Studio sync/import can target the exact mission branch or is preferred for branch publication.

CEP has two governed Writer execution classes with different transport/custody workflows. CHATGPT_WRITER uses the connected-chat tool environment and must not assume a durable local Git clone/worktree, branch checkout, or reliable large-blob Git push; its isolated candidate/heavy result custody goes to Google Drive with exact hashes/IDs. GOOGLE_AI_STUDIO_WRITER uses a manually materialized exact Git mission branch with live preview; because this workflow has no governed Drive-output writer path, after explicit Owner visual approval it may commit bounded generated result evidence under the mission writer-output subtree on its candidate branch. Secrets, credentials, node_modules, caches, runtime SQLite state, generated dependency trees and unrelated historical packages remain forbidden. Writer class changes transport/custody only and never relaxes parent binding, authority, Product truth, no-self-promotion or Controller audit. The AI Studio mission lifecycle is PREPARE_NO_MUTATION -> SMALL_BATCH_EXECUTION_AND_PREVIEW -> OWNER_VISUAL_REVIEW -> FINAL_EVIDENCE_CAPTURE_AND_BRANCH_PUSH -> CONTROLLER_AUDIT. Branch-materialization specifics are governed by OD-20260921-069.

When an authorized Writer discovers a real reproducible correctness/runtime bug that materially blocks, crashes, or corrupts the current authorized work, CEP must not preserve or build on the known-broken behavior merely because the defect appears during a preparation/no-planned-mutation phase or outside the current visual batch. A bounded prerequisite correctness repair is permitted before continuing only when the root cause is exact, the change uses the narrowest existing canonical owner/seam, introduces no new architecture/dependency/domain semantics/design scope, and focused plus affected regression evidence proves the repair. The repair must be separately recorded and remain subject to Controller review. Uncertain, broad, architectural, cross-owner, semantic, or design-expanding defects still stop for Controller adjudication; this rule never authorizes opportunistic feature work or silent scope widening.

For CEP Writer/Controller visual work, browser/network/localhost navigation failure must be treated separately from browser launch, rendering, JavaScript/DOM execution, pointer/keyboard interaction, screenshot creation/inspection, video capture/validation, and genuine route/platform proof. A Writer must use the bounded local/offline recovery ladder in `WRITER_LOCAL_VISUAL_CAPTURE_AND_RENDERING_METHOD.md` before declaring visual capture blocked.
